summary: Grove got the big refactor I've been planning for months — 63 features condensed down to 21, which cleans up the codebase and lays a better foundation. Comments are now a core feature out of the greenhouse, and the markdown editor has footnote support. There are also a lot of fixes under the hood, like consolidating database tables and making sure sign-ups work smoothly for the free plan.
